learning_outcomes.text: Students are prepared to lead product development and innovation projects and teams to success within the framework of a holistic and strategically oriented project management (also incorporating agile methods).
Students can explain the most important tools of project management and apply the elementary technical vocabulary.
Students are able to lead/manage a project within a given organizational project structure.
Students can develop and purposefully apply control options for various project phases (controlling the degree of completion, cost controlling).
Students can explain the specific features of team building and project leadership.
Students can moderate team meetings for projects.
Students know instruments of IT-supported project management.
Students can explain the importance of corporate goals and are able to differentiate between different leadership cultures.
Students can name essential aspects of industrial property rights.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of innovation and project management (terms/methods/tools)
Fundamentals of setting up creativity workshops
Project phase models and planning systems (project preparation, project planning, project execution, project completion)
Project planning (project structure plan / -cost plan / -resource plan / -schedule)
Specifics of method application in innovation projects (strategic preparation / initiation, planning, monitoring and control of innovation projects)
Leading project and innovation teams (social structures, special communication situations in projects, real and virtual project work, problem analysis and action concepts)
Stakeholder management (influencing factors for successful project management)
Trainings and workshops on selected technical examples
Basic aspects of industrial property rights
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
